title: A tab does not indent the continuation line inside a flow collection
notes: Tabs are separation inside a flow collection, but only after the indentation: a flow collection that is the value of a block mapping at indentation 0 is parsed with n = 1, every following line starts with the flow line prefix (production 69, exactly one space, then optional white space), and a line that starts with a tab has no space. yaml-test-suite Y79Y/003 (a tab-led entry in a flow sequence inside a sequence) and DK95/01 are errors for the same reason. A tab-only line is still fine as an empty or comment line (Y79Y/002). The top-level flow collection of 6CA3 and Q5MG is valid because the prefix there needs no spaces. A tab may start a comment line, so `b` is the first character that cannot belong.

provenance.reference: A reader that counted the tab as indentation inside a flow collection and accepted the input as a sequence of the string `a b`.
